en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a cobbled path and small bridge leading to an arched gateway covered in ivy, with a large historic building complex and a church-like tower in the background. On the right is a stone staircase leading up to a pointed-arch doorway of the castle. Two figures (an adult and a child) are walking over the bridge. At the bottom in cursive German script are captions indicating the location and subject.
